text:
Sam: Postmortem (IO cache evictions) is live. We need follow-ups: repro/regressions, promptset additions, sustained load, and an automated alert -> test pipeline. Link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/io-cache-2026

Priya: +1. Action breakdown: (1) deterministic replay regression, (2) 90m sustained working-set load, (3) promptsets & evals, (4) chaos drill. I can track tickets and timelines.

Marta: I'll own (1). Plan: small replay harness that consumes sanitized trace bundles and asserts eviction ordering + tail metrics. Output should be CI-friendly JSON. ETA 8 business days.

Kai: I'll export two representative traces and run the scrub job to remove PII/IDs. Will drop bundles in s3://incidents/io-eviction/sanitized/ and link to the ticket. ETA 36h.

Taylor: I'll do (3) promptsets & evals. Two promptsets: `eviction-short` and `eviction-long` plus an eval job that reports P95/P99 and a simple correctness metric. Acceptance: P95 <= 1.25x baseline, correctness delta < 0.5%. ETA 6 days.

Marta: For replay tests, suggest naming and labels so they're easy to find:
`tests/eviction/kv_replay.yaml`
`tests/eviction/kv_sustained_90m.yaml`
labels: ["regression","eviction","kv","nightly"]

Priya: I'll open PERF-6001 "eviction-90m-sustained" and PERF-6002 "eviction-replay-harness" and assign owners. Also flag infra for temporary quota.

infra-bot: PERF-6001 and PERF-6002 created and linked to IO-CACHE-2026. CI template `eviction-suite-nightly` available.

Kai: Quota request posted to infra-schedule. Trace scrub links will be in PERF-6002 in ~36h.

Marta: I'll include a small README showing how to run locally with a sanitized trace and example expected JSON output. PR checklist: 1) harness + tests, 2) sanitized traces, 3) CI job, 4) perf ticket, 5) acceptance doc.

Taylor: I'll push promptsets to eval-runner and add golden output artifacts to the PR for automated comparisons.

Priya: Chaos drill plan: tabletop (20-30m) then one controlled staging eviction run. Marta leads live run, Kai infra, Taylor evals. I'll schedule the tabletop next Thu 10:00.

Marta: Also proposing an alert automation: when eviction rate > 0.5% for 10m AND P99 > 2x baseline, auto-create an Ops breadcrumbs ticket and run a fast regression job to capture traces. I'll draft rule and post in alerts RFC.

Sam: Nice. Owners recap: Marta (harness + chaos lead), Taylor (promptsets + evals), Priya (perf tickets + scheduling), Kai (traces + infra), Sam (follow-up & tabletop). Everyone drop ETAs into the tickets by EOD.

infra-bot: CI job `eviction-suite-nightly` scheduled to run daily at 03:00 UTC after PR merge.

Sam: Thanks team — I'll convert this thread into the follow-up doc and link PERF-6001/6002 + resulting PRs. :thumbsup:
